objective: Search directly for an actual D2C root with |A|>=4, at least one tight matched pair, and at least two complementary A code-pair classes.
generator: Start from Erdos-Renyi graphs of orders 8..18 at densities 0.25,0.30,0.35,0.40,0.45,0.50,0.55,0.60,0.70,0.80; retain connected diameter-2 starts; greedily delete edges in deterministic random order until inclusion-minimal diameter 2 (D2C).
interpretation: The earlier complete-Hall-cut zero-hit phenomenon persists under a materially different D2C generator and all-root scan. Among 244 diversified generated roots with |A|>=4 and p>0, none has more than one complementary A code-pair class. This is strong bounded evidence for a graph-level single-pair-class obstruction, not a proof. The two generated multi-class roots have |A|<4 and therefore cannot support a rigid cut with |X|>=3 and nonempty Y.
